_why: Every module-level constant eidolon_sdk/biz/contracts publishes, and what was decided about it: mirrored to a named Dart constant, or deliberately not mirrored with a reason. A constant in neither column fails tool/check_wire_contract_mirror.py. The scope is the whole file on purpose — it used to be a list of name prefixes, and that list went short by twenty constants, three of which this client had mirrored all along with nothing checking them.

SESSION_CONVERSATION_ID_MAX_LENGTH.not_mirrored: carried by sessionConversationIdPattern's length bound, which the checker verifies against this value rather than as a separate constant

SESSION_INTENT_PRESENCE.not_mirrored: presence-initiated sessions are begun by the Host orchestrator; this client never asks for one, and roomJoinSessionIntent deliberately reads anything it does not know as a normal user session

SESSION_FLOW_ID_FIELD.not_mirrored: correlates a flow across Hub components; nothing on this client reads or produces it

SESSION_END_IDLE_NORMAL.not_mirrored: this client branches on SESSION_END_ERROR against everything else, so a legitimate end needs no individual name: the screen tells a person whether something broke, not which of five ways a conversation finished

SESSION_END_USER_LEFT.not_mirrored: this client branches on SESSION_END_ERROR against everything else, so a legitimate end needs no individual name: the screen tells a person whether something broke, not which of five ways a conversation finished

SESSION_END_PROACTIVE_DONE.not_mirrored: this client branches on SESSION_END_ERROR against everything else, so a legitimate end needs no individual name: the screen tells a person whether something broke, not which of five ways a conversation finished

SESSION_END_SUPERSEDED.not_mirrored: this client branches on SESSION_END_ERROR against everything else, so a legitimate end needs no individual name: the screen tells a person whether something broke, not which of five ways a conversation finished

CONTROL_OP_PLAYBACK_STOP.not_mirrored: a Host to device operation this client does not implement

CONTROL_OP_PTT_TURN_STATUS.not_mirrored: push to talk is not a mode this client offers; it is full duplex only

CONTROL_OP_DEVICE_ROLL_CALL.not_mirrored: a Host to device operation this client does not implement

CONTROL_OP_GUARD_VISION_BENCHMARK.not_mirrored: guard vision runs on boards with a camera; this client publishes no video

CONTROL_OP_GUARD_RUNTIME_SYNC.not_mirrored: guard runtime is not part of a phone Body

CONTROL_OP_GUARD_OWNER_FACE_PROFILE_SYNC.not_mirrored: guard face profiles belong to the vision path this client does not have

CONTROL_OP_ALIASES.not_mirrored: a computed alias table over the operations above; not a value a client sends

EVENT_TOPIC.not_mirrored: device to Host telemetry events; this client emits none yet

CLIENT_AUDIO_STATE_KNOWN_KEYS.not_mirrored: a computed frozenset the server filters incoming keys with; not a value a client sends

INTERACTION_MODE_HALF_DUPLEX.not_mirrored: this Body declares interaction_mode as a pinned full_duplex const in its Manifest and never offers the half-duplex alternative; zero occurrences in lib/

INTERACTION_MODE_PTT.not_mirrored: push to talk is a mode this client does not offer; the value 'ptt' is too short to search for reliably, so this is reasoning rather than a measurement

INPUT_MODE_AUTO.not_mirrored: input mode is a board-side capture concept; this client publishes through livekit_client, which owns its own capture. The value 'auto' is too short to search for reliably

INPUT_MODE_MANUAL.not_mirrored: input mode is a board-side capture concept this client has no equivalent of; zero occurrences in lib/

INPUT_MODE_PTT.not_mirrored: input mode is a board-side capture concept this client has no equivalent of; the value 'ptt' is too short to search for reliably

INPUT_MODE_UNKNOWN.not_mirrored: input mode is a board-side capture concept this client has no equivalent of; 'unknown' is far too common a word to search for

PLAYBACK_STATE_UNKNOWN.not_mirrored: this client reports only speaking or idle on the audio-state topic and never the unknown third state; 'unknown' is far too common a word to search for

VALID_CONTROL_OPS.not_mirrored: a computed set the server validates incoming ops against; a client sends one op, not the set

VALID_INPUT_MODES.not_mirrored: a computed set over the input modes above, none of which this client has

VALID_INTERACTION_MODES.not_mirrored: a computed set; this Body pins one interaction mode in its Manifest rather than choosing from the set at runtime

VALID_PLAYBACK_STATES.not_mirrored: a computed set the server validates against; this client sends one state at a time

VALID_SESSION_END_REASONS.not_mirrored: a computed set over the end reasons this client does not consume

VALID_SESSION_INTENTS.not_mirrored: a computed set; roomJoinSessionIntent deliberately treats anything it does not recognise as a normal user session rather than validating against a mirrored set

VALID_SESSION_REQUEST_TYPES.not_mirrored: a computed set over sessionOpenType and sessionCloseType, both mirrored; sessionRequestPayload refuses anything else by naming the two rather than by carrying the set
